The company, which owns the point-of-sale business management platform Clover, cut its full-year revenue growth outlook to between 3.5% and 4%, down from the 10% it projected just three months ago.  The company now expects 2025 profit-per-share to come in between $8.50 and $8.60 per share, down from previous guidance of $10.15 to $10.30 per share.

data.headline: Analysis-From Alphabet to Visa, US giants drive euro-denominated bond surge

The likes of Google-parent Alphabet, Visa, PepsiCo, payments firm Fiserv and Verizon have sold bonds denominated in euros recently.
